name: WHEEL CRAFT: Creative Physics
summary:
Wheel Craft: Creative Physics is a sandbox-style physics game where your creativity directly controls how your vehicle moves. Instead of choosing pre-made parts, you design your own wheels by drawing them on a digital tablet. Your drawing instantly becomes a real 3D wheel attached to your car, and the physics engine determines how it performs.
